svg.aria-label: CPU throttling with cgroup quotas: a container limited to 2 CPUs gets 200 ms of CPU time per 100 ms period; a burst using 8 threads spends the quota in 25 ms and is frozen for the remaining 75 ms, so requests see latency spikes even though average CPU looks low.
svg.title: CPU throttling with cgroup quotas: a container limited to 2 CPUs gets 200 ms of CPU time per 100 ms period; a burst using 8 threads spends the quota in 25 ms and is frozen for the remaining 75 ms, so requests see latency spikes even though average CPU looks low.
svg.text: fix: thread pools sized to the limit (not host cores), higher limits or no CPU limit for latency services
